title: DFM for FDM 3D printing
description: Printability rules for a 0.4 mm nozzle and 0.2 mm layers: printable walls, limited unsupported overhang, material around holes.

up.description: Build direction: x, y or z.

min_wall.description: Thinnest wall (mm): 3 perimeters of a 0.4 mm nozzle.

max_overhang_deg.description: Largest unsupported overhang angle from vertical (degrees).

rules.citation: Guideline: FDM with a 0.4 mm nozzle needs at least 3 perimeters (1.2 mm) for a closed wall; vault note Standards/Design-Rules-FDM
Guideline: FDM overhangs steeper than 45 degrees from vertical need support; vault note Standards/Design-Rules-FDM
rules.note: Re-orient the part, add a chamfer instead of a fillet on bottom edges, or accept supports.

rules.citation: Guideline: keep at least 3 perimeters (1.2 mm) of material around printed holes
ISO 2768-1:1989, Table 1 (permissible deviations for linear dimensions); process capability per DUCAD guideline
rules.note: Printed holes come out about 0.2 mm undersize; ream or drill the ones that need a fit.
